policy.cross_domain_caveat: Different constructs can still share lyrics, models or provenance. C is not evidence of independent measurement or causality.

domain_rationale.chart_performance: Ranks, exposure counts and chart-point totals.
domain_rationale.historical_calendar: Calendar placement, including linked release year.
domain_rationale.lyrical_affect: GoEmotions and sentiment measure related affective constructs; conservatively grouped together.
domain_rationale.lyrical_content: LyricLens and Detoxify measure overlapping content moderation constructs.
domain_rationale.musicbrainz_metadata: Counts and recording-length summaries from the same linked metadata evidence.

policy.evaluation: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY: the 2018-onward test was inspected in the unrestricted campaign; no newly untouched holdout is claimed.
policy.precedence: A if any reconstruction rule applies; otherwise B if any predictor shares the target domain; otherwise C. Mixed B/C models remain B with cross-domain tags.
retained_examples: MusicBrainz counts remain B, including counts versus durations.
Total chart points versus weeks/rank remains B: sum(101-rank) cannot be recovered exactly from count plus best rank.
Monthly sample count versus weekly count remains B: sampling and gaps affect the counts.
A single episode endpoint versus a count remains available; the two-endpoint combination is excluded.

rules.explanation: Rows and distinct chart dates count the same weekly appearances; duplicates are the documented exception.

First/last weekly dates and first/last selected months locate the same observed chart career. Exclude these alternative calendar coordinates as episode reconstruction, including opposite endpoints. They are not asserted to be mathematically identical; gaps and monthly sampling matter.

Min/median/max summarize the same set of distinct positive recording lengths. Treat predicting one length summary from another as reconstruction of the same physical measurement. Different versions prevent universal equality; this is an explicit interpretation restriction, not an equality claim.

Both a first and a last coordinate bound the same chart-history window whose observations/months are counted. Exclude interval-to-exposure reconstruction. Counts need not equal elapsed intervals because of gaps; this conservative scope rule follows the shared history window, not a correlation threshold.
The other two softmax outputs reconstruct the remaining sentiment probability. Already forbidden by the original campaign; this policy does not restore those candidates.

policy.selection: Filter saved complete validation hierarchies; retain original skill/k/id order. No final-test values or correlation cutoffs enter the policy.
